name: Vision Mod

author: Enigma AI Engine

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Take a screenshot of the full screen or a region

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze an image or capture and analyze the screen

prompt.description: Analysis prompt or question about the image

commands.name: ocr

path.description: Path to image file (captures screen if omitted)

commands.description: Start periodic screen capture at an interval

commands.name: load
commands.description: Load capture, OCR, and analyzer components
